During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Free Spacers Fleet]], allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], '''engaged and defeated''' the [[Imperial Seventh Fleet]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]]. The Free Spacers Fleet was led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zale Barrows]], who later went on to defend the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].
